title: SvgLinearGradient
responsibility: Renders the native linearGradient element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgLinearGradient.attributes
inputs.description: Native linearGradient attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgLinearGradient.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native linearGradient element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgLinearGradient
outputs.description: The actual native linearGradient element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
